name: Voxel-Space Coherency Sampling
aliases: Coarse-to-Fine Adaptive Sampling with Pyramid Detection
definition: A method using voxel-space coherency to start sampling at low frequency (large steps) and increasing density where value differences are large.
summary: Voxel-Space Coherency Sampling is an image-space optimization that uses a volume pyramid to detect local frequency, allowing it to skip uniform regions and adapt step sizes more effectively than methods relying solely on per-ray density estimates.
